annotations.text: Title drawn: "Fee rules" (plain, covers charging AND waiving; the hub row renames to match). Alternates if you prefer: "Fees and waivers" · "What the law says about fees" · keep "What the law lets you charge".

Kevin's call 2026-08-27: NO fifth tab — the waiver content joins the EXISTING tabs as a "Fee waiver" section on each. State mandate: the old conflated "Fee waiver grounds" row splits into the two § 552.267 rules (22 → 23 loaded; the estimates group drops from 9 to 8). City decisions: two policy questions (who decides · denial wording); de-minimis stays where it was, cross-referenced as the § 552.267(b) threshold.

Gates: the two waiver choices count toward ATTEST (and the hub evidence line) but NOT toward Approve — fee schedule v1 still waits only on the 13 money figures. Silent-state behavior: the Fee waiver section renders one honest "law does not address waivers (researched)" line on the mandate tab, and the city-decisions group opens with the offer-a-waiver-at-all question.

Build implications: hub row `waiver_policy` deleted (lane 12 → 11; verify_setup_hub counts change again) · the fee_waiver profile SECTION stays (15-section set is fixed) and attests through this screen — fee_law attest covers both sections, or fee_waiver folds into fees (decide at build) · who-decides is the existing approvalModules waiver module · the 5 stock sentences are the existing decision_reasons store, read-only until the letter-template slice.
